changelog:
CSM 1.0.876

Updates
• Updates automatically follow the loaded installation: CSM stays on Normal and CSM Dev stays on Dev. The manual channel picker is removed.
• Improve update ownership, cancellation and stale completion handling.

Settings and appearance
• Direct settings areas, selectable navigation layouts, relevance-ranked search and clearer values, counts and prerequisite hints.
• Category-specific reset and recovery preserve unrelated settings and local account state.
• Improve saved gradients, recycled-card animations and immediate settings refresh.
• Correct settings width changes between phone and TV configurations and guard host metadata access on older Android versions.
• Resume Offset can be configured with Auto Resume enabled while the global CSM switch is off; playback changes still require CSM to be enabled.
• Global Font Scale remains hidden and inactive. Saved and imported values are preserved; CloudStream's native text sizing remains in use.

Player and Discord
• Player action controls use CloudStream's existing sizing and focus links; refine quick actions and the next-episode notice.
• Optional Discord progress timestamps follow the actual player position and duration, re-anchor after seeking or resuming, and use paused elapsed time instead of a moving bar.
• Simplify the activity-card preview and preserve title, hover-text and account ownership choices.
• Keep unsupported TV handoffs from reporting playback that was never started, and separate Watch Party's protocol identity from the extension version.

Diagnostics
• Add an offline self-test dashboard with complete TXT/JSON reports, explicit failed or untested checks and owner-aware cancellation.
• Keep component-check results separate from functions that require an active player, account, network or device.

Stability and privacy
• Isolate failing injection steps and improve per-feature diagnostics without skipping unrelated steps.
• Harden stale player, dialog, download and sharing callbacks after disable, navigation or owner replacement.
• Validate settings transfers before a checked import and preserve private, local-only credentials and state.
• Keep unsupported and retired options unavailable.

Physical playback, audio effects, Discord rendering and transfers between devices have not been verified.
message: CSM 1.0.876 — installed-channel updates and lifecycle stability
